components.explanation: game/main.gd and game/main.tscn: title -> intro -> fight -> ko -> result -> rematch on the physics tick; both fighters stepped, then hits checked. The loop B01-B02 show, as it exists on desktop (commit 6317281 onward; test_runner.gd 94 / 0).

fighter/cpu_controller.gd: re-decides every 10 ticks with a seeded generator; blocks a close attack at 55 %, walks in out of kick range, steps back when too close, kicks in range at 50 % with a 40-tick cooldown. Its Intent drives fighter.gd like the player's keys.
fighter/player_controller.gd reads the p1_* actions (game/controls.gd); the capture bot sends those actions with Input.parse_input_event, so the capture is real input handling.

tests/test_runner.gd (94 / 0) and the A5-A7 suites whose logs B08 shows: test_hurt_flash (69 / 0), test_hit_spark_state (57 / 0), test_embers_state (38 / 0), test_kick_edges (38 / 0), test_pins_a7 (19 / 0).
